format: per take: fire tick, hit tick (or timeout), target speed, side scale, head speed. 20 ticks a second.

look.hot_spots: L2/L3: noise along the line, 0.5 blocks, moving 0.4 b/tick
look.corner_flares: L3: 0.12-block flare at each corner, pulsing

underwater.W1: 1 bubble a tick, 0.05-0.1 blocks, rise 0.06 b/tick
underwater.W2: 4 small bubbles a tick hugging the line, 7-tick life
underwater.W3: 1 bubble a tick + a steam puff at each new corner

F1.name: fast flyer 30 b/s: sides x1.4, chase at 95% of its speed

W3.name: under water: bubbles + steam at the corners
